company_name: Dual-Win Innovation (Shanghai) Precision Equipment Technology Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in semiconductor-grade polymer materials and manufacturing processes.
summary: Dual-Win Innovation (Shanghai) Precision Equipment Technology Co., Ltd. provides semiconductor-grade solutions focusing on a wide range of fluoropolymers and high-performance materials. They offer comprehensive R&D and manufacturing capabilities, including ultra-clean molding and various molding techniques, tailored for semiconductor applications.
capabilities: High-performance polymer materials (PEEK, PI, PAI, PBI)
technical_expertise: Specialized molding and processing equipment development

regional_presence.China: The company has established R&D and production facilities in Songjiang, Shanghai and Jiashan, Zhejiang.
